trigger_condition: initialStickyOptions prop is empty at mount; async parent fetch resolves later
guard_snippet: useEffect(() => { if (initialStickyOptions?.length) { setStickyOptions(prev => { const m = new Map(prev); initialStickyOptions.forEach(o => m.set(o.value, o)); return m }) } }, [initialStickyOptions])
potential_consequence: Sticky cache never seeded; pre-selected user chip shows no label

potential_consequence: setSeedUserOptions called on unmounted component; stale state update

trigger_condition: User clicks analytics link before listProjectBudgets resolves; memberBudgets is still []
